title: The Forest Can't Stand on the Ice

sources.title: Multi-sensor satellite analysis reveals latitudinal and morphometric controls on ice phenology across 31 000 lakes on the Alaska North Slope
sources.outlet: The Cryosphere 20, 6501 to 6519, Nguyen, Lopez, Melara-Valle, Ross, Bradley, Limbeck, Masteller and Michaelides, Washington University in St. Louis, published November 12th (peer-reviewed paper, full text read)
sources.note: Random forest of 100 trees on six Sentinel-1 radar features dates ice-on and ice-off for 30,774 North Slope lakes, 2019 to 2023. 94 percent agreement with Sentinel-2 labels, no field validation. DOI 10.5194/tc-20-6501-2026.
